summary: Build the full BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge Career Guidance Program as a website + app: student registration, delivery of all 150 assessment questions, automated scoring, detailed editable career report generation, and persistent storage/retrieval of results.

existing_features.title: Implement student registration and user account management using Internet Identity login on the frontend, and persist a student profile in the Motoko backend keyed by the authenticated principal (create on first login, fetch/update on subsequent logins).

Create the full test-taking workflow to deliver all 150 assessment questions in the React app, including: start assessment, progress indicator, navigating questions, saving responses, review screen, submission/finish, and preventing data loss on refresh by loading the in-progress session state from the backend.

Generate a detailed career guidance report after scoring, and provide a fully editable report format in the frontend (rich sections/fields editable by an authorized user) with backend persistence for edits and versioning metadata (e.g., last updated time, updated by).

Create the end-to-end website workflow in the frontend for the BELKRISHNA GlobalEdge program, including: landing/dashboard, student onboarding/profile, assessments list, active assessment experience, results/scores view, report viewer/editor, and history screen for past sessions and reports.

Apply a coherent, creative visual theme across the frontend (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) suitable for a career guidance/education product, and enforce it consistently across all pages and states.

Add generated static image assets required by the app into frontend/public/assets/generated and render them appropriately in the UI (e.g., in the landing and/or dashboard screens) without routing images through the backend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement student registration and user account management for the program
Deliver all 150 assessment questions in-app/web with a complete test-taking workflow
Implement automated scoring/assessment logic for the tests
Generate detailed career guidance reports with a fully editable report format
Store and retrieve student test sessions, scores, and generated reports
Create the website workflow plus companion app experience to deliver the end-to-end program

Implement automated scoring/assessment logic in the Motoko backend for the 150-question assessment, producing a structured score output that can be used to generate a career guidance report; expose backend methods to compute and retrieve scores for a completed session.

Implement persistent storage and retrieval for student test sessions, responses, computed scores, and generated reports in the single Motoko actor, including backend APIs to list a student's historical sessions/reports and fetch any specific record by ID with access control enforcing that only the owning principal (or an explicitly defined admin role) can access it.
